reason: The official HM Land Registry INSPIRE download window exposes monthly GML Polygon geometry for registered freehold property, with a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID per polygon. This materially changes the parser/spatial route from identifier-only lookup tables to authoritative polygon geometry. However the project's canonical_parcel_id inventory and canonical parcel Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry are not exposed in this public window, so a deterministic local spatial join from canonical_parcel_id to an INSPIRE polygon cannot be performed; consequently no canonical parcel can be classified or assigned a proven building type.
